slug: 2026-01-20 Building Open Digital States Country Case Studies on the Impact of DPGs for DPI

facts.fact: The Digital Public Goods Alliance case study states that DHIS2, adopted in Rwanda in 2012, is used by 700+ facilities, with data completeness rising from 88 to 95 per cent and timeliness from 60 to over 90 per cent; the tier of the facilities, a denominator and the year of the figures are not given, so the date is the document's published date (itself a proxy from PDF metadata).

systems.tiers: 700+ facilities, tiers not stated; adopted 2012; also used to track COVID vaccination and tests with national-ID linkage

note: The mirror holds key facts extracted from the PDF, not its body. DHIS2 is classed hmis on the completeness and timeliness of reporting it describes; the 700+ count is of facilities of unstated tier, not expressly primary clinics, and the reviewer may prefer to drop it from clinics.
